children: An INK-like Go terminal renderer that draws PortableDoc blocks inside the Go TUI's paper viewer.

pdrender is a Go package at internal/pdrender that renders PortableDoc block trees as styled terminal output — think INK, but in Go and aimed at the terminal. It is not a standalone client; it is a rendering engine embedded inside the Go TUI, so it sits within the Surfaces family of Barkpark as the piece that turns structured documents into readable terminal frames.

The Go TUI's paper viewer hands pdrender a PortableDoc — Barkpark's portable block format — and gets back laid-out, styled output. That includes Bulldocs papers: a Bulldocs document is a tree of PortableDoc blocks (headings, paragraphs, callouts, code), and pdrender is what makes one legible in a terminal instead of dumping raw JSON. The document itself arrives over HTTP API v1 — served by the Phoenix API — like any other Document.

Because prod's post-merge build compiles the Go TUI — and pdrender with it — the shared go.mod is held at go 1.24.2. Bumping it risks breaking the Production build that produces the TUI binary, so the pin is a hard constraint, not a preference.
